parent_objective: design decisive T4/T5 history-necessity task matrix after standard profile scaling stop rule
blocked_by: standard public profile distribution does not support finite-window history necessity or online-GRU hidden advantage
supersedes: another standard fixed-budget profile pilot without decisive history tasks
immediate L3 recipe repair before proving the task needs older history

public_gates: M1499 must design T4 same-current same-recent-window different-older-history tasks
M1499 must design T5 terminal-boundary near-constraint tasks
M1499 must define L0/L1/L2/L2-current-tiled/L3/reset controls under shared budgets
M1499 must block training, PPO, replay, private holdout, promotion, corpus export, and actor-input changes
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim level3 self-identification from design alone

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: opens a new branch that designs tasks where current frame and short recent windows should be insufficient by construction
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, PPO, replay, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if tasks cannot separate current frame from older action-response history
stop if tasks require non-deployable actor inputs
stop if control profiles receive unequal budgets
stop if design uses private holdout for tuning
fallback_plan: if T4 construction is infeasible, first build a no-training paired-state miner
if T5 near-boundary construction is too brittle, use an audited public candidate bank before training
if both T4 and T5 are infeasible, record a negative self-ID task-design verdict
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: new decisive-history branch opened by M1498 pivot

admission_evidence: M1498 stops standard profile scaling after M1497 repeated current-frame substitution and reset-control trends
M1492 pre-registered T4 and T5 as decisive self-ID task families
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation or no-training task-smoke manifest
next_stage_criteria: T4 and T5 task families are explicitly defined
controls and shared budgets are explicit
success and falsification criteria are pre-registered

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1499 is a design milestone whose purpose is to create tasks that control current-frame substitution directly.
history_necessity_tests: define same-current same-recent-window different-older-history T4 pairs
define terminal-boundary T5 tasks where early belief changes collision or clearance
define current-tiled and reset controls as mandatory diagnostics
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: design only; no new temporal evidence generated.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If decisive tasks cannot be constructed without shortcuts, record that as negative task-design evidence instead of weakening level3 self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: After the standard profile stop rule, the correct next paper route is to design decisive T4/T5 tasks that make older action-response history necessary under fair controls.
success_criteria: design defines T4 same-current same-recent-window different-older-history task family
design defines T5 terminal-boundary near-constraint task family
design defines required controls and shared budgets
design pre-registers success and falsification criteria
design blocks training PPO replay promotion private holdout corpus export and actor-input changes
failure_criteria: T4/T5 tasks do not isolate older-history necessity
design uses private holdout for tuning
design starts training replay PPO promotion corpus export or actor-input change
decision_rule: M1499 passes if it defines a fair decisive-history task matrix before any implementation or training.
